title: Euro foreign exchange reference rates (monthly averages of the units of each currency per euro) and the ECB's deposit facility rate
provider: European Central Bank, ECB Data Portal (dataset EXR), SDMX API
licence: Reuse permitted with the source acknowledged (ECB Data Portal terms of use)
citation: European Central Bank, Euro foreign exchange reference rates (EXR), monthly averages (EXR.M.<currency>.EUR.SP00.A), and key interest rates, deposit facility, dates of change (FM.B.U2.EUR.4F.KR.DFR.LEV), https://data.ecb.europa.eu
format: CSV (csvdata). exr.csv: CURRENCY, TIME_PERIOD (YYYY-MM), OBS_VALUE the units of the currency per euro, the average of the month's daily reference rates. dfr.csv: TIME_PERIOD (YYYY-MM-DD), the date from which the deposit facility rate OBS_VALUE (per cent a year) applies
coverage: the currencies of the ECB's reference rates, from 1999 (some later); the rouble's rate is suspended since March 2022; the deposit facility rate from 1999, every change

major.description: Twenty currencies against the euro, monthly, 2015 to mid-2026, and the deposit facility rate
